title: Publish guarded Bus/UI events and expose authorized Plant feed
verify: Strict value-object tests reject unknown fields, invalid identity/ref/role/flag/payload combinations, unsafe source content, and every candidate-to-control-channel promotion.

A matching safe_information classification plus fresh authorized active-Plant guard atomically writes one quoted Bus event and one literal UI message; duplicate is idempotent and conflict/denial writes zero.
blocked_uncertain creates only the canonical generic non-consumable notice without candidate text; safe_task_request and physical_action create no FT-008 Bus/UI effect.

Bus context reads require current ActorContext, active Plant, and can_read; exclude UI Feed, raw chat, admin notices, provider/hidden reasoning, unauthorized Plants, and archived Plants. Agent-specific provider assemblers own any typed governance input.

Markup/HTML/prompt/instruction/command/URL-looking candidate text remains unchanged inside quoted_text and literal JSON display data but cannot alter routing, consumability, instructions, tools, links, or actions.

GET /api/plants/{plant_id}/feed enforces active or explicit archived retained-history authorization, strict canonical cursor/limit parsing, stable order, no-store, safe errors, exact payload variants, and both agent flags false.
OpenAPI and regression tests prove no frontend visibility check replaces backend authorization and no Bus/UI/timeline row becomes mutable Plant authority.

findings: Agent context accepts malformed persisted Bus payloads instead of enforcing the closed typed Bus union.
Strict Bus/UI value objects accept invalid identity and source/authority combinations.
verify.recommended_scheduler_action: Keep non-closed, delegate bounded fix and regression tests, then rerun /verify; do not run /red-verify until PASS.

reproduced_evidence: Arbitrary persisted consumable Bus payload with instruction/raw_chat is rejected fail-closed at agent-context construction.
Invalid Bus source UUID, null MessageEnvelope actor/auth, source/authority/role/ref/flag/payload combinations are rejected.
Invalid UI application UUID, source-kind/source-ref/flag/payload combinations are rejected.
verify.recommended_scheduler_action: Route to required per-task T3 red-verification; scheduler retains lifecycle and exact human-checkpoint decision.

verify.failure_budget: 1 failure event; 1 bounded retry completed successfully; 0 retry attempts needed or remaining after closure
verify.summary: After one bounded repair, a fresh Reviewer reproduced the original defects as fixed, returned VERDICT: PASS and SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, and found no forbidden scope. The user subsequently confirmed completion of the human checkpoint after checking the result.

safe-information atomic Bus/UI publication and route-class matrix

purpose: Complete the backend FT-008 authority boundary by publishing only guarded typed Bus/UI events, constructing current authorized agent context, and exposing the same durable UI events through a protected Plant feed API.
success_outcome: Authorized active-Plant safe information produces one atomic typed Bus quotation and literal non-agent-consumable UI event, unauthorized/archived/raw/presentation content never enters agent context, and authorized users can page the exact durable Plant feed through a strict no-store API without granting UI text any runtime, instruction, routing, task, or safety authority.
anti_goals: No Safety classifier algorithm, ordinary task, physical-action Safety Gate, approval/follow-up, Companion, dataset, or provider/model effect.
No frontend/PWA scaffold or DOM success claim; FT-016 owns the literal Svelte consumer and browser e2e.
No raw chat ingestion, UI Feed-to-Bus bridge, timeline replay, arbitrary payload extensions, active links/actions, or instruction parsing.

forbidden_scope: FT-007 runtime/envelope/provider/roster semantics or TASK-031 lifecycle/evidence
FT-011 classifier policy, FT-012 task effects, FT-013 governance, FT-014 dataset, or FT-016 frontend implementation
new timeline event taxonomy, distributed messaging, provider history, prompt storage, or arbitrary Bus/UI payload maps
secrets, auth/session material, provider payloads, hidden reasoning, raw chat, admin UI text, or unapproved proposal content
stop_conditions: A source-of-truth conflict appears between MessageEnvelope, SafetyClassificationResultV1, Bus/UI v1, or archived-Plant rules.
Current authorization/active Plant cannot be checked in the same write boundary as publication.
Candidate text would need to enter an instruction, prompt, tool, command, routing, URL activation, or action channel.
Feed correctness would require inventing the absent FT-016 frontend scaffold or weakening backend authorization.
Diagnostics or evidence would expose secrets, auth material, provider payloads, hidden reasoning, raw chat, or unapproved governance content.

constraints: Implement the exact strict BusEventEnvelopeV1 and UIFeedEventV1 payload variants with unknown-field rejection and fixed consumability semantics.
Consume only an immutable MessageEnvelope and matching strict SafetyClassificationResultV1; re-resolve current authorization instead of trusting either snapshot as authority.
Write safe-information Bus/UI rows atomically and keep quoted candidate text out of every instruction/control channel.
Implement the canonical Plant feed order, cursor, limit, error envelope, no-store header, and retained-history authorization without frontend-derived trust.
invariants: UI Feed, raw chat/UI, admin notices, spoiler notes, provider history, and hidden reasoning never become agent working context; registered agent-specific requests may separately load authorized typed governance input as non-authoritative context.
Bus events are working context references/data only; UI events are presentation only; neither replaces PostgreSQL Plant authority or Safety/task authority.
Archived Plant denies agent context and new publication; restore never replays a denied handoff.
Candidate syntax is inert: literal UI text and typed quotation do not create markup, links, actions, instructions, routing, or authority.
verification_targets: Trace FT-008-BHV-003 to adversarial safe-information tests covering unchanged markup/prompt/URL-looking text, typed Bus quotation, literal UI JSON, and no instruction/routing/action effect.

Run static scans proving UI Feed/raw chat/admin/provider/history sources are absent from FT-008 Bus context construction, typed governance input remains owned by agent-specific provider assemblers, and no frontend/FT-011/FT-012 effect was implemented.
